methodology.purpose: Reusable features for song and member similarity graphs.
methodology.missingValuePolicy: Use null when no reliable value was found.
methodology.tagPolicy: Conservative English kebab-case tags inferred from lyrics, official descriptions, interviews, and published musical analysis.

analysis.notes: Fast summer idol-pop built around a playful beach romance and the confidence of being the cutest girl on the shore.
A somber train journey links passing scenery with emotional separation, memory, and feelings left unsaid.
A shy bus-seat crush framed through gravity and shared motion as invisible emotional connection.
Bright summer pop using a running Labrador as an image for pursuing a beachside crush.

songs.title: Kiss wa Matsu Shikanai no deshou ka?

analysis.notes: An inward, library-set crush wondering whether a girl must wait passively for a first kiss.
A beach romance about moving a close relationship forward. Published tempo estimates vary from about 144 to 148 BPM.
A Team 8 dance number using a beehive metaphor for synchronized group energy and movement.
A youthful romantic daydream used as the ending theme for the live-action drama Hoshikuzu Telepath.
A coastal discovery song in which two close friends suddenly recognize that their feelings have become romantic.
A high-energy theater anthem about collective effort, gratitude, and raising the curtain on a new chapter.
Rejects the wish to rewrite the past and instead treats past choices as the route to the present self.
A danceable encounter with an ex and her new partner, mixing swagger with jealousy and a wish to reconcile.
A whimsical love-at-first-sight story that casts an independent, captivating person as a unicorn who changes everything.
A crush makes crowded trains, exams, and ordinary pressures feel bright and enjoyable.
Two people remain physically close while losing emotional warmth and considering a breakup.
A fast, bright anthem that frames love and memory as something meant to endure into the future.
A suspended, ambiguous kiss dissolves the narrator's confidence and replaces it with tender uncertainty.

songs.title: Biisan wa Naze Nakunaru no ka?

analysis.notes: A barefoot summer confession that treats romance as something spontaneous and best attempted before youth passes.
A very fast, impatient countdown to summer, the beach, and finally confessing a crush.
A dramatic love-and-resolve song shaped by professional-wrestling imagery, confrontation, and a decisive ending.
A warm novelty song where different vegetables represent complementary strengths and cheerful teamwork.
A graduation-night rooftop romance that turns approaching dawn into urgency to act.
A narrative crush begins like Cinderella and ends with the painful discovery that the fantasy was one-sided.
Presents social media as an anonymous refuge for honest connection while explicitly warning against abuse and harassment.
A modernized disco number mixing a noisy costume party with flirtation and communal dance.
Sleet and cold wind mirror pride, lingering breakup regret, fading warmth, and beautiful memories.

songs.title: Sou Yuu Toko Aru yo ne?

analysis.notes: A fast comic-jealousy song about enduring a partner's tactless friendliness and complicated social circle.
A humorous anti-overwork message: admit weakness, pause when needed, and reject constant pressure to perform.

credits.arranger: nasu nomura / Tadd Kagatsume / KRATING / YAMOTO

analysis.notes: A clock-driven romantic contest where attraction shifts like a game and neither side knows when to make the next move.
An openly celebratory proposal and wedding song about finding one person among billions.
A mature summer attraction song comparing sudden desire to lightning crossing the body before thunder arrives.
A fast-moving love song about feelings that may be more than a crush and hesitation to admit them.
A light-footed transition from spring to summer, using sandals as a symbol of freedom, authenticity, and readiness for romance.
A very fast comic fantasy in which a fan imagines an idol on television is secretly his girlfriend.
A retro-styled collaboration with Iyo Matsumoto, pairing nostalgic idol-pop color with one-sided admiration.
A comic, self-assured defense of loving an unconventional boy whom everyone else dismisses.
A fast but bittersweet sakura song centered on farewell, lingering memory, and a bright future.
A childhood friend moving away forces the narrator to recognize love and act before the farewell becomes permanent.
A youth anthem treating hope, dreams, tears, and the desire to run toward tomorrow as irrepressible impulses.
Alien and space imagery describes outsiders recognizing one another, finding belonging, and sharing dreams.
A sparkling seaside first-kiss song built around the memory of a twelve-second kiss.
A seaside memory of an unspoken first love; the seawall doubles as a metaphor for emotional restraint and distance.
A high-impact love-at-first-sight song that treats intuition as a reliable glimpse of a shared future.
Uses seeds, flowers, and invisible threads to argue that meetings and future possibilities have meaning rather than being random.
A brisk summer-idol song whose angel image and amusement-park visuals emphasize bright youthful attraction.
A cheeky school-life song that mocks earnest ideas of youth while revealing the insecurity underneath that pose.
A mature anxiety song about discovering that youth has an endpoint and adulthood arrived without adequate preparation.
A snowy first-date song whose jumping motif turns bad weather into shared energy and laughter.
A brisk song whose migratory-bird metaphor connects leaving home, uncertainty, ambition, and continuing toward a destination.
A comic crush narrative about hiding a cat allergy to accept an invitation from someone with a cat.
A chant-driven encouragement to gather courage and confess before the romantic moment passes.
A fast summer reunion song where a familiar pink skirt restores affection after time and surroundings have changed.
A buoyant debut song where thinking about a crush makes an ordinary Monday commute feel weightless.
Fast, bright summer idol-pop about a long friendship turning into unspoken love during a seaside trip as the admired girl grows up.
An emotionally charged graduation single about quietly leaving a loved one at dawn, accepting loneliness, and choosing an uncertain dream over present happiness.
